newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL- CNS lower after news.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL- CNS lower after news.

text.p: CNS Inc shares fell in after-hours trading to 8-3/8 from their closing price of 11-1/4 after the company said it expects first quarter earnings to fall significantly short of analysts' consensus projections.
But other than CNS, few issues were active, traders said.
"It's very, very quiet after hours," one trader said.
CNS was down 3/4 of a point during regular trading, which was interrupted by a Nasdaq halt before it released its earnings forecast.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 33,400, compared with 5,900 on Thursday. Session two volume was 2,396,100, while on Thursday it was 17,823,703.
